g.text: // "static void main" must be defined in a public class.
// Creating the min heap and max heap
PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>(); // empty min heap
PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder()); // T: O(1), S: O(1)
// Adding elements to min heap and max heap
System.out.println("MIN HEAP: MIN: " + minHeap.peek()); // T: O(1), S: O(1)
// removing elements from min heap and max heap
System.out.println("After Polling: MIN HEAP: MIN: " + minHeap.peek());
System.out.println("After Polling: MAX HEAP: MAX: " + maxHeap.peek());
// size of min heap and max heap
System.out.println("MIN HEAP: Size: " + minHeap.size()); // T: O(1), S: O(1)
System.out.println("MIN HEAP: Is Empty: " + minHeap.isEmpty()); // true // T: O(1), S: O(1)
System.out.println("MAX HEAP: Is Empty: " + maxHeap.isEmpty()); // false
PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeapUsingHeapify = new PriorityQueue<>(Arrays.asList(20, 10, 17, 30, 40)); // // T: O(n), S: O(1)
System.out.println("After Polling: MIN HEAP 2: MIN: " + minHeapUsingHeapify.peek());
System.out.println("MIN HEAP 2: Is Empty: " + minHeapUsingHeapify.isEmpty()); // false
System.out.println("MIN HEAP 2: Is Empty: " + minHeapUsingHeapify.isEmpty()); // false
